summary: Input validation on case rejection reason across three entry points (console, CLI, queue); fits story_with_design because it needs a file-by-file plan for validation logic placement in existing rejection flows.

steps.why: Convert the detailed acceptance criteria into Given/When/Then requirements with technical notes.
steps.instructions: Focus on the three rejection entry points (console, CLI, queue) and the validation rules for the reason field. Keep the out-of-scope items clear.

steps.why: Multiple entry points for rejection need a file plan showing where validation is centralized and how each path calls it.
steps.instructions: Identify the console handler, CLI command, and queue processor for rejections. Show where the reason validation function lives and how each entry point uses it. Include the trim-before-save logic.

steps.why: Five acceptance criteria with specific edge cases (empty, whitespace-only, trimming) need explicit test coverage.
steps.instructions: Map tests 1:1 to the five ACs. Cover all three entry points, whitespace variations (spaces, tabs, line breaks), and the queue's paused-with-message behavior.

steps.why: Requirements, LLD, and tests must agree on validation rules and the three entry points.
Human approval of specs and this plan before Dev.

skipped.why: Scope and acceptance criteria are concrete and internal-facing; no product ambiguity or user-facing decisions.
